cells.gaps: No source found says how users sign in to the Citizen Portal, whether by the national ID or by one account shared across ministries. No source found gives users, applications or transactions through a national portal. The World Bank's March 2026 count of 25 information services and one transactional service is of the portal's discontinued earlier version.
cells.note: The new Citizen Portal, presented at FACIM 2026, provides about 26 services in September 2026 (MOZ-005, MOZ-003), newer than the World Bank's count for the discontinued earlier version (MOZ-009), so ten or more are online. No source says how users sign in, so the single-gateway rung is not met.
